blocked_candidates.reason: The absolute claim that Finnish and EU law cannot conflict is not an honest account of legal conflicts and EU-law primacy. The anthology supplies no precise primacy rule to turn into a source-supported question; the general duty to respect EU law is covered separately.

The claimed Finland-production-only limit on advertising identification is incorrect. KKV explicitly says that marketing directed to Finnish consumers is covered regardless of where it was produced. The supported advertising-identification principle has a card; this opposite jurisdiction claim needs source correction.
